releaseNotes: V894 addresses the exact 14:25:17 multi-client reproduction: the local V893 instance logged no transport, Refresh, PD-source, identity, latch, or PDO event at the moment the lamp went dark while the diagnostic 17 seconds later still reported TCP connected, 8 ports connected, and Watchdog Ok. This indicates the master's PDO TX image was changed externally without a local recovery edge.

LIVE Runtime now performs a bounded read-only PDO continuity audit for ACTIVE Studio output ports. One active port is checked every 200 ms in round-robin order by reading the master's current last-TX PDO image and comparing it with the existing locally confirmed coordinator shadow.

A mismatch never replaces the Runtime desired image. It only arms the existing generic PDO recovery path with reason master-tx-readback-mismatch; the next normal Runtime scan reasserts through PdoOutputCoordinator after the same SYSTEM READY, VID/DID, connected-port, ISDU-idle and config-transition guards pass.
No low-level transport/ISDU/PDI/PDO coordinator implementation was modified. The watchdog is read-only until a verified mismatch is observed, and read errors are rate-limited in diagnostics.

en: Added bounded ACTIVE-PDO hardware readback continuity auditing for external/multi-client TX-image changes that do not create a local reconnect edge.
A detected master TX mismatch arms the existing generic Runtime reassert path; no additional PDO writer is introduced.
The audit checks one ACTIVE port every 200 ms in round-robin order and skips ISDU/config-transition windows.
ko: 로컬 reconnect edge 없이 외부/다중 클라이언트가 master PDO TX image를 변경하는 경우를 감지하도록 ACTIVE PDO hardware readback continuity audit를 추가했습니다.
master TX 불일치가 확인될 때만 기존 generic Runtime reassert를 arm하며 별도 PDO writer는 추가하지 않았습니다.
audit는 200ms마다 ACTIVE 포트 1개를 round-robin으로 확인하고 ISDU/config-transition 구간은 건너뜁니다.
ja: ローカル reconnect edge を伴わない外部/複数クライアントによる master PDO TX image 変更を検出する ACTIVE PDO readback continuity audit を追加しました。
master TX mismatch を確認した場合のみ既存 generic Runtime reassert を arm し、新しい PDO writer は追加しません。
audit は 200ms ごとに ACTIVE port を1つ round-robin で確認し、ISDU/config-transition 中はスキップします。
zh-CN: 增加 ACTIVE PDO 硬件回读连续性检查，用于检测不会触发本地 reconnect edge 的外部/多客户端 master PDO TX image 变化。
仅在确认 master TX 不匹配时启用现有 generic Runtime reassert，不增加新的 PDO writer。
检查每 200ms 轮询一个 ACTIVE 端口，并跳过 ISDU/config-transition 窗口。
de: Ein begrenztes ACTIVE-PDO-Readback-Audit erkennt externe/mehrfache Client-Änderungen am Master-TX-Image ohne lokalen Reconnect-Edge.
Nur bei bestätigtem Master-TX-Mismatch wird der bestehende generische Runtime-Reassert-Pfad aktiviert; kein zusätzlicher PDO-Writer.
Alle 200 ms wird genau ein ACTIVE-Port im Round-Robin geprüft; ISDU-/Config-Transition-Fenster werden übersprungen.
es: Se añadió una auditoría de readback de PDO ACTIVE para detectar cambios externos/multicliente del TX image del master sin un reconnect edge local.
Solo un mismatch confirmado del master TX activa el reassert genérico existente; no se añade otro writer PDO.
La auditoría revisa un puerto ACTIVE cada 200 ms en round-robin y omite ventanas ISDU/config-transition.
